facts.name: Effective Policy Start Date

facts.name: 20-Pay Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: The type of policy is 20-Pay Whole Life.

facts.name: Insured Name: Robert James Ellison
facts.sentence: The name of the insured is Robert James Ellison.

facts.name: Date of Birth
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured is January 22, 1976.

facts.name: Issue Age: 50
facts.sentence: The issue age of the insured is 50.

facts.name: Standard Tobacco Risk Class
facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured is Standard Tobacco.

facts.name: Base Face Amount
facts.sentence: The base face amount of the policy is $500,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: The annual premium required by the policy is $12,460.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payments
facts.sentence: The frequency of premium payments is annual.

facts.name: 20-Year Premium Payment Period
facts.sentence: The period during which premiums are due lasts 20 years.

facts.name: Final Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The final premium due date is April 15, 2045.

facts.name: Maturity at Age 121
facts.sentence: The maturity date of the policy occurs when the insured reaches age 121.

facts.name: Maturity Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The maturity date corresponds to January 22, 2097.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Designation
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is the Ellison Family Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Insured Person Identified
facts.sentence: The insured person is Robert James Ellison.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the policy is the Ellison Family Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the primary beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the policy is the Estate of the Insured.

facts.name: Notice Address Location
facts.sentence: The address for notices to the owner is on file with the Company.

facts.name: Limited Pay Whole Life Definition
facts.sentence: A Limited Pay Whole Life policy refers to whole life insurance where premiums are scheduled to end after a fixed number of years while coverage continues for life.

facts.name: Trust Owner Definition
facts.sentence: A Trust Owner refers to the trustee acting on behalf of the named trust owner.

facts.name: Net Cash Surrender Value Definition
facts.sentence: Net Cash Surrender Value equals cash value minus any surrender charge and policy debt.

facts.name: Endowment Maturity Date
facts.sentence: Endowment Maturity refers to the date on which the policy matures at age 121.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Planning
facts.sentence: This policy is designed for estate liquidity planning.

facts.name: 20-Year Premium Payment Term
facts.sentence: Premiums under this policy are payable for 20 policy years only.

facts.name: Post-Premium Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: After the last scheduled premium is paid, coverage continues without further premium, subject to policy terms.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This policy is a non-participating policy.

facts.name: Non-dividend-paying policy
facts.sentence: This policy does not pay dividends.

facts.name: Estate Preservation Rider Attached
facts.sentence: An Estate Preservation Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Estate Preservation Rider Benefit
facts.sentence: The Estate Preservation Rider enables an accelerated underwriting review process for trust-owned policy increases.

facts.name: Trust-Owned Policy Increase Window
facts.sentence: Requests for trust-owned policy increases can be submitted within the first 5 policy years.

facts.name: Rider Benefit Approval Condition
facts.sentence: Approval for increased benefits via the Estate Preservation Rider is subject to company approval.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation Mechanism
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $88,40.

facts.name: Policy Term Duration
facts.sentence: A policy term spans five policy years.

facts.name: Continuation Beyond Five Years
facts.sentence: Company approval is required for continuation beyond five policy years.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates based on the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $88,400.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 20 is $216,500.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period
facts.sentence: A surrender charge applies during the first 12 policy years.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Reduction
facts.sentence: The surrender charge decreases annually until it reaches zero after 12 policy years.

facts.name: Net Cash Surrender Calculation
facts.sentence: Net cash surrender value equals cash value minus surrender charge and policy debt.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment Schedule
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually in advance.

facts.name: Grace Period After First Payment
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period follows the first premium payment.

facts.name: Premium Non-Payment Consequence
facts.sentence: If the premium is not paid by the end of the grace period, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Non-forfeiture Continuation
facts.sentence: The policy can continue under a non-forfeiture provision if the premium is not paid timely.

facts.name: Loan Availability After Year 3
facts.sentence: Loans become available after the end of policy year 3.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 85% of the net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Policy Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is 6% per annum.

facts.name: Loan Interest Payment Terms
facts.sentence: Loan interest is payable in arrears.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Priority
facts.sentence: A collateral assignment filed by the owner takes precedence over beneficiary claims up to the secured interest amount.

facts.name: Debt Impact on Benefits
facts.sentence: Any outstanding indebtedness reduces both death proceeds and surrender values.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer pays the base face amount to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Death benefits are reduced by policy debt.

facts.name: Death Benefit Assignments
facts.sentence: Death benefits are subject to any existing assignments.

facts.name: Lump Sum Death Proceeds
facts.sentence: Death proceeds may be paid as a single lump sum to the trust owner.

facts.name: Interest Settlement Option
facts.sentence: Death proceeds may also be paid under an interest settlement option chosen by the trustee.

facts.name: Policy Termination & Death Benefit
facts.sentence: No death benefit will be paid if the policy terminates prior to the insured’s death.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Options Eligibility
facts.sentence: Non-forfeiture options are available after three full years of premium payments.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender is one of the available non-forfeiture options.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Option: Reduced Paid-Up
facts.sentence: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance is one of the available non-forfeiture options.

facts.name: Extended Term Insurance Option
facts.sentence: Extended Term Insurance is one of the available non-forfeiture options.

facts.name: Automatic Extended Term Purchase
facts.sentence: If no election is made among non-forfeiture options, Cash Surrender Value is automatically used to purchase Extended Term Insurance.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: This policy may be reinstated within three years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Overdue Payments
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: This policy may be reinstated within 3 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums with 5.5% interest.

facts.name: Policy Loan Repayment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires repayment or reinstatement of policy loans.

facts.name: Suicide Containment Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date limits payment to total premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date results in exclusion of unpaid loan interest from payout.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts the face amount to the amount the paid premium would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: Rider Increase Contestability
facts.sentence: Any increase approved under the Estate Preservation Rider has its own contestability period.

facts.name: Contestability Period Start
facts.sentence: The contestability period for any increase under the Estate Preservation Rider begins on the date of increase.

facts.name: Suicide Period for Rider Increases
facts.sentence: The suicide period for any increase under the Estate Preservation Rider begins on the date of increase.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within 30 days after delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Refund
facts.sentence: Cancellation within 30 days after delivery results in a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: This policy constitutes part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Application as Contract Component
facts.sentence: The application constitutes part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Riders Part of Entire Contract
facts.sentence: Any attached riders constitute part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Entire Contract Definition
facts.sentence: The entire contract consists of this policy, the application, and any attached riders.

facts.name: Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: Centennial Reserve Life Company issued this policy.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location
facts.sentence: The policy was issued at Hartford, Connecticut.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy was issued on April 15, 2026.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Authorization
facts.sentence: The Secretary of Centennial Reserve Life Company authorized issuance.

facts.name: Whole Life Insurance Policy
facts.sentence: The policy is titled Whole Life Insurance Policy.

facts.name: Issuing Insurance Company
facts.sentence: The issuing company is Summit Heritage National Life.

facts.name: Policy Number Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is SHN-WL-2026-3049.

facts.name: Effective Policy Start Date
facts.sentence: The effective date of the policy is January 10, 2026.

facts.name: Single Premium Whole Life
facts.sentence: The policy type is Single Premium Whole Life.

facts.name: Insured Name: Helen Soo Park
facts.sentence: The insured's name is Helen Soo Park.

facts.name: Insured Birth Date
facts.sentence: The insured’s date of birth is November 30, 1961.

facts.name: Insured Issue Age
facts.sentence: The insured’s issue age is 64.

facts.name: Standard Non-Tobacco Risk Class
facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured is Standard Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Single Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The single premium amount is $150,000.

facts.name: Base Face Amount
facts.sentence: The base face amount is $268,000.

facts.name: Single Premium Payment Structure
facts.sentence: The payment frequency is Single Premium Only.

facts.name: No Additional Premiums Required
facts.sentence: There are no additional scheduled premiums.

facts.name: Maturity at Age 121
facts.sentence: The maturity date is Age 121.

facts.name: Maturity Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The maturity date corresponds to November 30, 2082.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identity
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Helen Soo Park.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Andrew Park, who receives 60% of the proceeds.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Grace Kim, who receives 40% of the proceeds.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is Park Legacy Trust, which receives 100% of the proceeds if primary beneficiaries predecease the insured.

facts.name: No Irrevocable Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: An irrevocable beneficiary election is not in effect for this policy.

facts.name: Single Premium Funding Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Single Premium Whole Life' policy means whole life insurance funded by one premium payment at issue.

facts.name: Definition of MEC
facts.sentence: A 'Modified Endowment Contract' or 'MEC' refers to a contract treated under federal tax law as a modified endowment contract.

facts.name: Net Amount at Risk Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Net Amount at Risk' is defined as the death benefit minus the cash value.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Surrender Charge Period' is the 10-year period beginning on the Effective Date during which a surrender charge may apply.

facts.name: Single Premium Funding
facts.sentence: This policy is funded by a single premium and no additional scheduled premiums are required.

facts.name: Legacy Transfer Intent
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for legacy transfer.

facts.name: Conservative Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for conservative cash value accumulation.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is not participating.

facts.name: No Dividends Payable
facts.sentence: No dividends are payable on this policy.

facts.name: MEC Classification
facts.sentence: This policy is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract.

facts.name: Loan Tax Consequences
facts.sentence: Any loan taken from this policy may have adverse tax consequences.

facts.name: Withdrawal Tax Risks
facts.sentence: Any withdrawal made from this policy may have adverse tax consequences.

facts.name: Assignment Tax Risks
facts.sentence: Any assignment of this policy may have adverse tax consequences.

facts.name: Tax Advice for Policy Transactions
facts.sentence: The owner should consult a tax adviser regarding any loans, withdrawals, or assignments.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation Mechanism
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 5 is $142,300.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $158,200.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 5 is $142,300.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $158,200.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Timing
facts.sentence: Partial surrenders are permitted after policy year 2.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Minimum
facts.sentence: Minimum amount for a partial surrender is $2,500.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Reduces Cash Value
facts.sentence: A partial surrender reduces the cash value.

facts.name: Partial Surrender Impact
facts.sentence: A partial surrender may reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Period
facts.sentence: A surrender charge applies during the first 10 policy years.

facts.name: Loan Availability After Anniversary
facts.sentence: Policy loans are available after the first policy anniversary.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit Based on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 90% of net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest accrues daily at 5.25% per annum.

facts.name: Interest Capitalization
facts.sentence: Unpaid interest is capitalized on each policy anniversary.

facts.name: Policy Debt Lapse Risk
facts.sentence: Policy debt may cause the contract to lapse.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will pay the beneficiary the base face amount.

facts.name: Death Benefit Adjustment
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will subtract partial surrenders from the base face amount when paying the beneficiary.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will subtract policy debt from the base face amount when paying the beneficiary.

facts.name: Lump Sum Payout Default
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are payable as a lump sum unless another settlement option is on file.

facts.name: Minor Beneficiary Payout Arrangement
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is a minor at the time of claim, payment may be made to a court-appointed guardian.

facts.name: Minor Beneficiary Payment Option
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is a minor at the time of claim, payment may be made under a minor settlement endorsement.

facts.name: Fully Paid Policy Status
facts.sentence: This is a fully paid policy.

facts.name: Fully Paid Policy Guarantee
facts.sentence: No premium lapse can occur from failure to pay scheduled premiums because this is a fully paid policy.

facts.name: Voluntary Surrender Before Termination
facts.sentence: If policy debt causes the policy to terminate, the owner may elect before termination to surrender the policy for its net cash surrender value.

facts.name: No Reduced Paid-Up Option
facts.sentence: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance is not available because this policy is already fully paid-up at issue.

facts.name: Reinstatement After Debt Termination
facts.sentence: Reinstatement may be requested within 2 years of termination if the policy terminated due solely to policy debt.

facts.name: Reinstatement Debt Repayment
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires repayment of debt.

facts.name: Proof of Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires proof of insurability if requested by the insurer.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires restoration of surrender value adjustments.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the effective date limits liability to the single premium paid minus any withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Age/Sex Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age or sex adjusts the death benefit to the amount the single premium would have purchased at the correct age or sex.

facts.name: Liability Limitation Timeline
facts.sentence: Two years from the Effective Date limits Summit Heritage National Life's liability.

facts.name: Liability Limitation Clause
facts.sentence: Summit Heritage National Life's liability is limited to the single premium paid minus any withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: A misstatement of age or sex will adjust the death benefit.

facts.name: Adjusted Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The adjusted death benefit equals the amount that the single premium would have purchased at correct age or sex values.

facts.name: Free Look Period
facts.sentence: The owner may return this policy within 10 days after delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: If returned within 10 days after delivery, the owner receives a full refund of the single premium.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after two years during the insured's life.

facts.name: Loan Default Exception
facts.sentence: This policy remains contestable after two years if there is nonpayment of amounts due under a loan agreement.

facts.name: Tax Reporting Compliance
facts.sentence: Summit Heritage National Life reserves the right to issue tax reporting required by law.

facts.name: Tax Reporting for Distributions
facts.sentence: Tax reporting may be issued for any reportable distribution.

facts.name: Guaranteed Issue Definition
facts.sentence: ‘Guaranteed Issue’ means no medical examination is required for issuance.

facts.name: Guaranteed Issue Definition
facts.sentence: ‘Guaranteed Issue’ means no health questions are required for issuance.

facts.name: Graded Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: ‘Graded Death Benefit’ means a reduced death benefit is payable during the graded period.

facts.name: Definition of Accidental Death
facts.sentence: ‘Accidental Death’ means death resulting directly and independently from an accidental bodily injury.

facts.name: Accidental Death Coverage Condition
facts.sentence: ‘Accidental Death’ means the accident occurred while the policy was in force.

facts.name: Final Expense Definition
facts.sentence: ‘Final Expense Policy’ means whole life insurance intended primarily to cover burial and related end-of-life expenses.

facts.name: Guaranteed Issue Basis
facts.sentence: This policy is issued on a guaranteed issue basis.

facts.name: No Post-Issue Increase in Face Amount
facts.sentence: No rider may increase the face amount after the policy is issued.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is non-participating.

facts.name: No Dividend Feature
facts.sentence: This policy has no dividend feature.

facts.name: Graded Death Benefit Period
facts.sentence: The death benefit is graded during the first 2 policy years.

facts.name: Full Death Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: Beginning on the third policy year, the full Base Face Amount is payable.

facts.name: Graded Death Benefit – Year 1 Non-Accidental
facts.sentence: If death occurs during policy year 1 from causes other than accidental death, the insurer will pay 110% of premiums paid.

facts.name: Graded Death Benefit – Year 2 Non-Accidental
facts.sentence: If death occurs during policy year 2 from causes other than accidental death, the insurer will pay 120% of premiums paid.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout Clause
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the first 2 policy years due to accidental death, the insurer will pay the full Base Face Amount.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: Accidental death occurring during the first 2 policy years results in a payment equal to 120% of premiums paid.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the first 2 policy years due to accidental death, the full Base Face Amount is payable.

facts.name: Post-Two-Year Death Benefit
facts.sentence: After completion of 2 policy years, the full Base Face Amount is payable for death from any cause not otherwise excluded.

facts.name: Cash Value Start Date
facts.sentence: Cash value begins at the end of policy year 3.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 5 is $1,480.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $4,020.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Calculation
facts.sentence: Cash surrender value equals cash value minus any policy debt.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Payment Method
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable monthly via bank draft.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Payment Method
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable monthly via direct bill.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Payment Methods
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable monthly through other methods approved by the insurer.

facts.name: Grace Period After First Payment
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after the first premium payment.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Unpaid Premium
facts.sentence: If the premium remains unpaid after the grace period, the policy will lapse.

facts.name: Loan Availability Condition
facts.sentence: Loans are available only after the policy has developed a cash surrender value.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit Based on Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 80% of cash surrender value.

facts.name: Policy Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is 7% per annum.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full years of premium payments, the policyowner may elect cash surrender.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Eligibility
facts.sentence: After 3 full years of premium payments, the policyowner may elect reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: No Extended Term Insurance
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available under this policy.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 2 years after lapse.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Terms
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums plus 6% interest.

facts.name: Reinstatement Without Medical Exam
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability is required for reinstatement if requested within 90 days after lapse.

facts.name: Suicide During First Two Years
facts.sentence: Suicide during the first 2 policy years is subject to the graded death benefit provisions outlined in Section 6.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts the face amount to the amount that would have been purchased using the premium at the correct age.

facts.name: No AD&D for Self-Injury
facts.sentence: Additional accidental death coverage is not provided for deaths caused by self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: This policy may be canceled within 30 days after delivery.

facts.name: Indexed Interest Based on External Index
facts.sentence: An 'Indexed Whole Life' policy refers to whole life insurance where credited interest to a policy value segment is partially based on the performance of a designated external index.

facts.name: Interest Caps and Floors
facts.sentence: Credited interest under an 'Indexed Whole Life' policy is subject to caps and floors.

facts.name: Index Segment Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Index Segment' is defined as a 12-month crediting segment established on each policy anniversary.

facts.name: Participation Rate Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Participation Rate' is the percentage of index growth that is recognized for crediting purposes.

facts.name: Floor Rate Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Floor Rate' is the minimum credited rate, which may be zero.

facts.name: Guaranteed Coverage with Indexed Credits
facts.sentence: This policy combines guaranteed whole life coverage with indexed value credits.

facts.name: Annual Allocation Options
facts.sentence: The owner may allocate each year’s policy value among three options: the Fixed Account, the One-Year Point-to-Point Index Segment, and the Capped Monthly Average Index Segment.

facts.name: Annual Allocation Process
facts.sentence: Allocation between account types occurs annually.

facts.name: Non-Investment Nature of Index Credits
facts.sentence: Index-linked credits are not direct investments in any security.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is non-participating.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy
facts.sentence: This policy does not pay dividends.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Rider Attached
facts.sentence: A Chronic Illness Accelerated Benefit Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Access
facts.sentence: Guaranteed minimum cash value is provided in the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum cash value at the end of Year 10 is $42,700.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum cash value at the end of Year 20 is $104,900.

facts.name: Fixed Account Rate – First Year
facts.sentence: The declared fixed account rate for the first policy year is 3.2 percent.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum cash value at the end of Year 20 is $104,900.

facts.name: Fixed Account Rate
facts.sentence: The declared Fixed Account rate for the first policy year is 3.25%.

facts.name: Initial Index Participation Rate
facts.sentence: The initial Participation Rate for the One-Year Point-to-Point Index Segment is 85%.

facts.name: Initial Cap Rate: 9%
facts.sentence: The initial Cap Rate for the Capped Monthly Average Index Segment is 9%.

facts.name: Floor Rate Protection
facts.sentence: Negative index performance will not reduce the credited value below the applicable Floor Rate.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Payment Timing
facts.sentence: Quarterly premiums are payable in advance.

facts.name: Grace Period After First Premium
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after the first premium.

facts.name: Secondary No-Lapse Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the policy account value is insufficient to support policy charges, a secondary no-lapse guarantee will keep the policy in force through the end of policy year 15.

facts.name: Secondary No-Lapse Guarantee Condition
facts.sentence: The secondary no-lapse guarantee requires cumulative premiums paid to equal the required guarantee premium schedule.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timing
facts.sentence: Loans are available after the first policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of the cash surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate is 5.5% per annum.

facts.name: Post-Year-5 Withdrawals
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals of at least $1,000 are permitted after policy year 5.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Cash Value
facts.sentence: Loans reduce the cash value.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Index Segments
facts.sentence: Loans reduce index segments.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Loans reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the cash value.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Index Segments
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce index segments.

facts.name: Withdrawals Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit equals the Base Face Amount minus policy debt.

facts.name: Death Benefit Includes Paid-Up Riders
facts.sentence: The death benefit includes any benefit from attached paid-up rider coverage.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Advance Payment
facts.sentence: Under the Chronic Illness Accelerated Benefit Rider, the owner may elect advance payment of a portion of the death benefit.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Rider Eligibility
facts.sentence: The insured must meet rider eligibility requirements to qualify for advance payment under the Chronic Illness Accelerated Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Any accelerated benefit paid reduces the remaining death benefit.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefits Reduce Cash Values
facts.sentence: Any accelerated benefit paid reduces cash values.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Options
facts.sentence: Available non-forfeiture options are cash surrender and reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: No Extended Term Option
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available under this indexed design.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years after lapse.

facts.name: Proof of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires proof of insurability.
